moments.name: Liftoff
moments.detail: The boarding bridge withdraws at Pelagic Anchor.

moments.name: The anchor falls away
moments.detail: Look through the floor port as the service fleet and its wakes come into view around the pier.

moments.name: Crest the cloud deck
moments.detail: Ride through the last bank and watch the sunlit towers fall below the carriage.

moments.name: Descending passenger carriage
moments.detail: Car C12 passes on the neighboring ribbon.

moments.name: The first stars
moments.detail: Watch the sky darken above the blue atmospheric limb.

moments.name: Freight on the counterline
moments.detail: The descending freight carrier crosses the guide assembly.

moments.name: Earth’s terminator
moments.detail: The line between daylight and night moves across Earth.

moments.name: Orbital night
moments.detail: Earth eclipses the sun. Look for city lights on the night side.

moments.name: Sunrise over the limb
moments.detail: Sunlight returns along the rim of Earth and across the tether.

moments.name: Aster Reach appears
moments.detail: The rotating habitat comes into view beyond the receiving hub.

moments.name: Into the receiving bay
moments.detail: Follow the guide rails into the capture collar.

moments.name: The galley bubble
moments.detail: Watch the gas pocket leave the lower wall as braking ends.

moments.name: Docked at Aster Reach
moments.detail: Braking ends at the nonrotating dock. Push off a handhold or release a carried item in microgravity.

observations.name: Stargazing from the saloon
observations.detail: Saloon lights off. Watch the forward glass as your eyes adjust. Guided holds 1× ship time here for 20 seconds.

observations.name: Pelagic Anchor harbor
observations.detail: Earthward optics follow the tug, pilot launch and supply ship as the pier falls away.

observations.name: Cable inspection tender T03
observations.detail: Look for T03’s open cable reel and the folded probe arms on its inspection frame.

observations.name: Shaded side window
observations.detail: Look opposite the Sun for the carriage’s shadow on the cloud.

observations.name: Valley gallery
observations.detail: The axial gallery looks down on the river, the waterfront station and the gardens turning beneath it.
